self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Ring of Yaxche: Using an Elemental Skill grants the Jade-Forged Crown effect: Every 1,000 Max HP will increase the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the equipping character by 1% for 10s. Normal Attack DMG can be increased this way by a maximum of 32%.

en.flavor: This jade vessel was created by a hero of yesteryear. Legend has it that it once shot the giant dragon that dwelt in the volcano down from the skies.

refinements.1: Using an Elemental Skill grants the Jade-Forged Crown effect: Every 1,000 Max HP will increase the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the equipping character by <r>0.6%</r> for 10s. Normal Attack DMG can be increased this way by a maximum of <r>16%</r>.
refinements.2: Using an Elemental Skill grants the Jade-Forged Crown effect: Every 1,000 Max HP will increase the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the equipping character by <r>0.7%</r> for 10s. Normal Attack DMG can be increased this way by a maximum of <r>20%</r>.
refinements.3: Using an Elemental Skill grants the Jade-Forged Crown effect: Every 1,000 Max HP will increase the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the equipping character by <r>0.8%</r> for 10s. Normal Attack DMG can be increased this way by a maximum of <r>24%</r>.
refinements.4: Using an Elemental Skill grants the Jade-Forged Crown effect: Every 1,000 Max HP will increase the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the equipping character by <r>0.9%</r> for 10s. Normal Attack DMG can be increased this way by a maximum of <r>28%</r>.
refinements.5: Using an Elemental Skill grants the Jade-Forged Crown effect: Every 1,000 Max HP will increase the Normal Attack DMG dealt by the equipping character by <r>1%</r> for 10s. Normal Attack DMG can be increased this way by a maximum of <r>32%</r>.

fr.flavor: Cet objet de jade a été créé par un héros d'autrefois. La légende raconte qu'il aurait un jour abattu du ciel le dragon géant qui résidait dans le volcan.

refinements.1: Utiliser une compétence élémentaire accorde l'effet Couronne de Jade : chaque tranche de 1 000 PV max augmente les DGT infligés par les attaques normales de <r>0,6 %</r> pendant 10 s. Les DGT des attaques normales peuvent être augmentés d'un maximum de <r>16 %</r> de cette manière.
